decision_note: Silene littorea petal-colour polymorphism study identifies non-pollinator-mediated selection on anthocyanins/photosynthetic tissues but does not measure a focal pollinator response to the colour coordinate.
Focused pollination-chemistry review addresses floral scent integration into pollination ecology without a focal plant antagonist/exploiter channel.
Dissertation on evolutionary transitions in plant reproduction centers mating-system/pollination evolution without a focal measured plant antagonist/exploiter response.
Rhododendron floral-syndrome and breeding-system study concerns pollination/reproductive biology without a focal plant antagonist/exploiter response.
Tomato far-red experiment alters flowering traits and pollinator interactions but does not measure a focal plant antagonist/exploiter response.
Arbuscular-mycorrhiza study links herbivory interactions to floral nectar energy but does not directly measure pollinator response/service in the focal experiment.
Floral phytochemicals are tested against a bumble-bee parasite; the parasite acts on the pollinator rather than as a plant antagonist/exploiter channel.
Supplementary XLSX table for the published Leaf Induction Impacts Behavior and Performance of a Pollinating Herbivore report; not an independent primary study.
Second supplementary XLSX table for the published Leaf Induction Impacts Behavior and Performance of a Pollinating Herbivore report; not an independent primary study.
Broad chapter on multifunctional terpenoids in plant defence and ecology is not focused on one floral trait/reward coordinate with measured pollinator and antagonist responses.
Network-robustness model introduces antagonistic interactions into plant-pollinator networks but does not identify a focal plant floral trait/reward coordinate.

Primary Turnera velutina experiment manipulates extrafloral nectar secretion, measures defensive ants, pollinator visitation and plant fitness, and directly tests ant-pollinator conflict; retain as a strong functional-boundary source.
Grapevine floral-volatile biosynthesis study characterizes sesquiterpene production without measuring pollinator response/service or an antagonist channel.
Sesamothamnus breeding-system and demography study concerns pollination/reproduction without a focal plant antagonist/exploiter response.
Stapeliad fetid-floral-odour chemistry study addresses pollination-associated scent chemistry without a focal measured plant antagonist/exploiter response.

Nicotiana attenuata dissertation explicitly links circadian regulation of reproductive and defensive traits to interactions with pollinators and herbivores; retain for chapter-level mutualist-antagonist adjudication.
Comparative Hedychium reproductive-biology study concerns breeding system and pollination without a focal plant antagonist/exploiter response.
Primary Isomeris arborea study directly measures consequences of floral herbivory for subsequent pollinator service; retain for herbivory-pollination functional adjudication.
Primary Thunia alba bract-removal experiment measures legitimate pollination, nectar robbing and male/female reproductive success; retain as a strong manipulated shared-trait boundary system.

Focused synthesis on context dependence of pollinator-mediated selection explicitly treats antagonistic interactions and factorial pollination-by-other-agent designs; retain as relevant synthesis/source-chasing material.

Primary Silene latifolia study partitions selection caused by a pollinating seed predator on flower size/number and contrasts predation-mediated with other selection; retain for coupled-role selection adjudication.
Primary Dichaea pendula study tests a major floral volatile that attracts both pollinators and florivores; retain as a strong shared-signal mutualist-antagonist candidate.
Primary Ecology study explicitly examines the dual role of floral traits in pollinator attraction and plant defence; retain for same-trait multifunctional geometry adjudication.
Alpine flower-visitor community survey records flies, bees and parasitoid wasps but does not measure a plant antagonist response or plant reproductive endpoint linked to a focal floral coordinate.

Dissertation on nectar secondary metabolites explicitly frames floral chemical traits as a pollinator-attraction versus herbivore-defence dilemma and experimentally studies pollinator responses plus defence-linked chemistry; retain for chapter-level source adjudication.
